id: podcast_digest
name: 播客摘要助手
type: plugin
description: 订阅播客 RSS 或导入音频链接，自动转写并生成分段摘要、重点摘录、时间戳目录和可分享的听后笔记。
short_description: Podcast transcription and digest generation with timestamps, highlights, and notes.
keywords: 播客, podcast, 音频, audio, 转写, transcription, 摘要, digest, summary, 时间戳, timestamp, RSS, 笔记, notes
passive: false
